name: Summer 2025 Riverine Flooding in Sindh and Punjab
location: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Western Punjab, and Sindh (specifically Kashmore, Ghotki, Sukkur, Shikarpur, Khairpur, Dadu, Naushero Feroz, Jamshoro, Larkana, Shaheed Benazirabad)
impact: Widespread inundation affecting 2.2 million people, 1,111 settlements, 30 hospitals, 45 schools, and 780 km of roads. Critical infrastructure at risk includes the Tarbela Dam reaching maximum capacity.
context: A convergence of climatic factors including La Niña, positive Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), and elevated Tibetan Plateau temperatures is driving heavy monsoon rainfall and glacial melt. This results in peak flood risks between July 27 and August 3, 2025, with flows reaching 500,000 cusecs at Sukkur Barrage.
